goals.description: Execute comprehensive codebase audit: document optimization opportunities across architecture, AI provider dispatch, and Qdrant memory configuration
goals.verificationCriteria: Detailed audit report generated identifying all architectural bottlenecks, invalid Qdrant configurations, provider coupling, and portability blockers
goals.evidence: Completed full codebase audit identifying: (1) Invalid Qdrant schema ('turbo4'/'turbo' hallucination) in src/memory.ts; (2) Decoupled MemoryCortex unused by swarmEngine; (3) Monolithic provider if-else block in Agent.run violating OCP; (4) Unintegrated AnalysisLifecycle & ModelRouter; (5) Fragile cross-directory import structure preventing clean library transplantation.

goals.description: Optimize Qdrant setup and Memory Cortex: fix invalid schema (turbo4/turbo), enable robust hybrid search, and support flexible embedding providers
goals.verificationCriteria: MemoryCortex uses compliant Qdrant schemas with int8 scalar quantization and on-disk payload; graceful fallback when embeddings or cluster unavailable

goals.description: Refactor Swarm Core into a standalone portable library package with pluggable Provider Adapters
goals.verificationCriteria: Clean provider adapter interface (Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, Mistral, GitHub) decoupled from Agent class; unified exports via src/swarm/index.ts with zero Express/React coupling

goals.description: Integrate Memory Cortex, Model Router, and Analysis Lifecycle into the Swarm Orchestrator for deep analysis
goals.verificationCriteria: SwarmEngine leverages MemoryCortex for semantic baseline retrieval and optional AnalysisLifecycle verification loops for high-complexity analysis tasks

goals.description: End-to-end verification, type checking, bundle build, and portability validation
goals.verificationCriteria: tsc --noEmit passes with 0 errors; vite build succeeds; sample portable consumer script verifies zero-framework invocation
